title: <id>.mod.json for an Unreviewed source, schema 1
description: The mod-level fields and one build's fields at the top level, published next to <id>.zip in each release: INDEX_FORMAT.md, '<id>.mod.json, for Unreviewed sources'. It must also agree with GitHub's record of the release (tag, repo, asset name, URL, size and digest), which a schema can't check. reviewed is never read from a source.
